claims.description: Text generated by `::before` and `::after` contributes to intrinsic text size and block flow.

notes.text: Parity covers generated strings and attribute content affecting intrinsic width, height, and following block placement.
Generated content contributes to its originating element's text measurement; independently styled pseudo boxes, counters, images, and pseudo-element hit targets are not modeled.

claims.description: Generated pseudo-elements with independent box styles remain outside the modeled layout tree.

notes.text: Display, positioning, independent typography, counters, images, and hit targets on generated pseudo-elements are not modeled.
